items.title: Claude Code 2.1.309 released
items.text: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command · Fixed macOS sandbox denyWrite glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink · Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with --mcp-config · Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions
